help: Start the source with a supported diagram header, for example flowchart.
rationale: Nothing is drawn until the first word names a diagram kind, so the whole file is ignored.

help: add a diagram header, for example flowchart
rationale: A file with no header has no diagram in it, so a render would produce nothing to look at.

summary: invalid config value VALUE for KEY
help: Write a value that the config key accepts.
rationale: A config value that does not parse leaves the diagram with settings nobody chose, so the layout can look wrong for no visible reason.

summary: anchor or alias TOKEN is not supported
help: Write the value without anchors or aliases.
rationale: An anchor or alias would silently change a value, and this tool does not resolve them, so the written text is the only truth.

help: Write the value without a tag.
rationale: A tag asks for a type the reader cannot honour, so the value would be read as plain text and surprise the author.

help: Check the spelling of the key, or remove it.
rationale: A key this tool does not know is never applied, so the diagram keeps the default the author meant to override.

summary: config key KEY is not supported by this project
help: Remove the key; this project cannot produce the output it asks for.
rationale: The key asks for output this project never produces, so leaving it in gives a false impression that the setting took effect.

summary: text width is measured with Inter; fontFamily is VALUE
help: Text widths may differ from the font named in fontFamily.
rationale: Widths come from a fixed font table, so a diagram whose text is set in another font can end up with different line breaks than the author expected.

help: Reduce the nesting to 64 levels or fewer.
rationale: Past 64 levels the structure stops being readable and the parser cannot hold it, so the source needs flattening.

summary: source has SIZE bytes; the limit is LIMIT bytes
help: Shorten the source, or raise maxTextSize.
rationale: An oversized file is refused rather than half parsed, so the author learns the limit instead of seeing a partial diagram.

summary: diagram has COUNT edges; the limit is LIMIT
help: Reduce the number of edges, or raise maxEdges.
rationale: A diagram past the edge limit cannot be laid out in the time the tool promises, so the author must split it or raise the cap.

summary: layout stopped at its iteration cap in PHASE
help: The diagram uses the best feasible result found so far.
rationale: The diagram is still drawn and valid, but the author should know that an improvement pass stopped early and the result can change between versions.

help: The source text is shown as written.
rationale: The command is printed literally instead of typeset, so the author can see which part of the formula did not become math.

help: The source text is shown as written.
rationale: A broken formula cannot be typeset, so the raw text stands in and the author gets the reason instead of a silently wrong symbol.

help: The diagram draws the unknown icon in its place.
rationale: A missing icon still leaves a marked placeholder, so the author sees which name did not resolve and can fix or drop it.

help: Use an http, https, or mailto link.
rationale: The link is dropped instead of emitted, so a shared diagram cannot carry a URL scheme that runs code on the reader's machine.
Output here is a static picture, so the author should not count on a click doing anything.
Bytes that are not UTF-8 put the offset of every later diagnostic at risk, so the file must be repaired before anything else can be trusted.
